title: {me}'s watchdog
noAnswer: the {channel} bridge has not answered for {minutes} minutes
loggedOut: {me}'s {channel} will not come back by itself: {why}. A restart does not help; someone has to see to it (sign in again, or put in new credentials).
restarted: restarted the {channel} bridge, it is connected again
actedOk: {me} had a problem just now and is back: {what}. Action taken: {did}. The cause is not fixed.
actedFailed: {me} has a problem that could not be fixed this time: {what}. Action taken: {did}.
gaveUp: {me} is still not well: {what}. The watchdog tried {n} times; Claude has been asked to look for the cause and its diagnosis will come here.
ccHint: To have Claude look into it or fix it, send "/cc <what you want>" here.
tellRole: [system notice, no need to answer {owner}] Something went wrong on your side just now: {what}. The watchdog did: {did}. Carry on as usual; if you notice anything related yourself, put it in today's diary.
ccDefault: {me} seems to have a problem; find out what it is (diagnose first, change nothing yet)
ccReceived:
[Claude] Got it, starting: {words}
(I will report here when done; usually a few minutes to half an hour.)
ccBusy: [Claude] The previous /cc is still running; send again when it has finished.
noOutput: no output (exit {code}; it may have run out of time)
diagnosisFailed: {me}'s watchdog wanted Claude to look for the cause; it did not start: {why}
noClaude: no claude command at {exe}; write its path into modules.watchdog.claude of the instance config
isFable: modules.watchdog.model names a Fable model ({model}); name another one
hhdSilent: {me}'s main process (hhd) has not answered, or not taken its messages, for {minutes} minutes
noReply: {me} has not answered your {n} messages on {channel} in {minutes} minutes. They all reached {me} and hhd is answering, so the cause is on {me}'s own side (quota, a refusal, or a long piece of work). The watchdog has not touched {me}.
senseNote.watchdog: the comms watchdog stepped in: which channel's bridge it restarted, and whether that brought it back
wizardAbout: Keeps its chat channels connected and tells you when one goes quiet.
